cases.title: 赛车工程技术手册信息图设计
cases.imageAlt: 赛车工程技术手册信息图设计
cases.prompt:
英文提示词:
Create a premium square “reference-style motorsport engineering infographic” centered around an elite futuristic racing car called the {RACING_CAR_NAME}, designed as a beautifully curated motorsport technology handbook page rather than a generic racing poster.
The composition should feel like a modern visual encyclopedia mixed with a professional race-engineering technical sheet and high-end editorial infographic system.
Visual Direction:
• 1:1 square composition
• Dark high-tech motorsport background with subtle carbon-fiber textures, blueprint overlays, telemetry graphics, and race-engineering schematics
• Elegant aggressive palette using matte black, gunmetal gray, deep red accents, titanium silver, and glowing performance highlights
• Refined editorial typography hierarchy with bold motorsport-inspired headers
• Rounded modular information cards with clean spacing
• Gentle cinematic reflections and premium HUD-style dividers
• Minimal but advanced race-engineering iconography
• Extremely detailed central racing car render viewed in dramatic low-angle three-quarter perspective inside a pit garage or race paddock environment
• Thin precision annotation lines pointing toward aerodynamic systems and motorsport engineering features
• Clean, organized “knowledge-first” layout with dense technical detail but highly readable spacing
Main Subject Presentation:
A stunning ultra-detailed realistic render of the {RACING_CAR_NAME} placed at the center, featuring carbon-fiber bodywork, aerodynamic splitters, massive rear wing, race slick tyres, exposed suspension geometry, glowing LED race lights, aggressive vents, sponsor-style detailing, and premium motorsport realism.
Surround the racing car with scientific and engineering callouts explaining:
• aerodynamic body design
• carbon monocoque chassis
• race suspension system
• high-performance braking system
• turbocharged/hybrid race engine
• diffuser and downforce systems
• tyre and grip technology
• cooling and airflow management
• driver cockpit systems
• telemetry and data systems
Include modular infographic sections such as:
• Vehicle Overview
• Technical Specifications
• Dimensions & Blueprint Views
• Performance Highlights
• Aerodynamic Performance
• Powertrain & Hybrid Systems
• Chassis & Suspension Engineering
• Brake & Safety Systems
• Driver Cockpit Technology
• Fuel & Race Strategy
• Tyre Performance Analysis
• Weight Distribution
• Track Performance Metrics
• Lap-Time Potential
• Competitor Comparison
• Pit Stop Optimization
• “Top 5 Race Innovations” section
• Race-Ready Features & Endurance Systems
Add small premium visualization modules like:
• aerodynamic airflow simulations
• telemetry/radar charts
• lap-time graphics
• engine cutaway diagrams
• suspension system illustrations
• race strategy visualizations
• tyre grip charts
• top/side blueprint schematics
• performance gauges
• pit-stop workflow graphics
Style Keywords:
“premium motorsport encyclopedia”
“editorial race-engineering handbook”
“high-end racing car infographic”
“scientific motorsport poster”
“museum-quality race car reference page”
“modular motorsport knowledge system”
“clean race-engineering editorial design”
“ultra-detailed racing visualization”
Avoid:
• cartoon racing aesthetics
• unrealistic sci-fi floating vehicles
• messy sponsor overload
• generic racing advertisement layouts
• crash scenes or destruction
• excessive neon cyberpunk effects
The final result should resemble a professionally published motorsport engineering reference-book page created for racing enthusiasts, engineers, collectors, automotive designers, motorsport teams, and educational automotive archives.

cases.title: 3D可爱风母女厨艺对决动画短片
cases.imageAlt: 3D可爱风母女厨艺对决动画短片
cases.prompt:
英文提示词:
14-second cute 3D style animated comedy short, ultra-detailed, vibrant colors, warm cinematic lighting, smooth 24fps animation, exaggerated expressions and physics, emotional and funny tone.    

SHOT 1 (0.00–1.00s) – Wide establishing shot, eye-level, slow push-in: Cozy modern apartment dining area with warm lighting, family photos on the wall, and a small dining table. A 30-year-old Chinese daughter (long dark hair in a messy bun, casual t-shirt and apron, looking nervous but hopeful) stands beside the table, smiling proudly while lifting a plate cover to serve her mother. The 60-year-old Chinese mother (short permed hair with some gray, wearing a comfortable cardigan and glasses, gentle face) is seated at the table, looking at her daughter with a warm, knowing smile. Soft background showing part of the open kitchen.    

SHOT 2 (1.00–2.00s) – Tight close-up, high angle, static: Beautifully plated but slightly imperfect homemade dish (seared fish, stir-fried vegetables, rice) on a simple ceramic plate. Daughter’s hands visible in background.    

SHOT 3 (2.00–3.00s) – Extreme close-up on 60-year-old mother’s face, eye-level: She takes a bite with chopsticks, eyes widen with delight then narrow playfully. She chews while giving a gentle, knowing side-eye to her daughter, one eyebrow slightly raised, soft smirk.    

SHOT 4 (3.00–4.00s) – Close-up on 30-year-old daughter’s face, eye-level, slight push-in: Her proud smile instantly drops into wide-eyed shock, mouth open, eyebrows raised high. She stares in disbelief.    

SHOT 5 (4.00–5.00s) – Extreme close-up on mother’s face again: She lowers her chopsticks slightly, now wearing a cheeky, loving grin, eyes sparkling with mischief as she looks directly forward.    

SHOT 6 (5.00–6.00s) – Wide shot, low angle in the home kitchen: 60-year-old mother now wearing a slightly oversized colorful apron, standing confidently in foreground in front of the stove. Daughter stands behind her in the doorway, looking surprised and confused. Mother has both hands on hips, determined and warm expression.    

SHOT 7 (6.00–7.00s) – Same kitchen wide shot, dynamic camera tilt down: Bright orange flames flare dramatically from the wok. Mother leans forward with focused energy, eyes narrowed in fierce but loving concentration, ready to cook.    

SHOT 8 (7.00–8.00s) – Dynamic close-up, low angle: Mother dramatically holds up a large kitchen knife, fierce yet caring expression, surrounded by flying slices of beef and vegetables in foreground that frame her like a dramatic action shot.    

SHOT 9 (8.00–9.00s) – Extreme close-up, low angle, fast-paced: Fresh ginger, garlic, and green onions being sliced, with juice and pieces flying in slow-motion around the knife, along with floating bok choy, cherry tomatoes, and chili peppers.    

SHOT 10 (9.00–10.00s) – Medium close-up in kitchen, eye-level: Mother intensely stirs a sizzling wok with a spatula, steam rising beautifully, strong flames underneath. Her face shows pure focus and confidence, slight warm smile.    

SHOT 11 (10.00–11.00s) – Tight close-up, high angle: Her hands elegantly plate the perfectly cooked dish (glossy stir-fried beef, vibrant vegetables, aromatic sauce) from the wok onto a plate using a spoon.    

SHOT 12 (11.00–12.00s) – Medium two-shot at the dining table, eye-level: Mother proudly holds up the finished plate toward her daughter. The 30-year-old daughter takes a big bite with chopsticks, eyes bulging in extreme delight and surprise.    

SHOT 13 (12.00–13.00s) – Close-up two-shot: Mother leans forward with a huge satisfied and loving smile, gently gesturing with her hand as if saying “See?” while looking at her daughter.    

SHOT 14 (13.00–14.00s) – Close-up on daughter’s face: She suddenly starts crying happy tears, big cartoon tears rolling down her cheeks, chopsticks still in hand.    

SHOT 15 (14.00s – end) – Final wide shot, eye-level, slow pull-back: Mother stands triumphantly beside the table, hands clasped, warm and smug satisfied smile. Daughter is sitting with her head slightly bowed in happy defeat, one hand dramatically holding her forehead while still crying joyful tears.    This version keeps the exact same comedic rhythm, timing, and emotional payoff as the original while changing the characters, setting, and cultural details to a heartfelt Chinese mother-daughter home cooking story.

中文提示词:
14秒可爱3D风格动画喜剧短片，细节极度丰富，色彩鲜艳，温暖的电影感灯光，流畅的24fps动画，夸张的表情和物理效果，情感丰富且带有幽默感。

镜头 1 (0.00–1.00s) – 全景转场，视线高度，缓慢推入：舒适的现代公寓餐厅，灯光温暖，墙上有全家福，一张小餐桌。30岁的中国女儿（深色长发扎成凌乱发髻，身穿休闲T恤和围裙，神情紧张却充满期待）站在桌旁，自豪地微笑着揭开盘盖为母亲上菜。60岁的中国母亲（短烫发带些银丝，穿着舒适的开衫和眼镜，面容慈祥）坐在桌旁，带着温暖且了然于心的微笑看着女儿。背景隐约可见开放式厨房。

镜头 2 (1.00–2.00s) – 特写，高角度，固定镜头：摆盘精美但略显瑕疵的家常菜（煎鱼、炒蔬菜、米饭）盛在简约陶瓷盘中。背景可见女儿的双手。

镜头 3 (2.00–3.00s) – 60岁母亲脸部大特写，视线高度：她用筷子尝了一口，眼睛惊讶地睁大，随后调皮地眯起。她一边咀嚼，一边带着慈祥且了然的眼神斜睨着女儿，一侧眉毛微挑，嘴角带着淡淡的笑意。

镜头 4 (3.00–4.00s) – 30岁女儿脸部特写，视线高度，轻微推入：她自豪的笑容瞬间凝固，变成瞠目结舌的震惊，嘴巴张开，眉毛高挑。她难以置信地盯着。

镜头 5 (4.00–5.00s) – 再次特写母亲脸部：她微微放下筷子，此时带着顽皮而慈爱的笑容，直视前方时眼神闪烁着恶作剧的光芒。

镜头 6 (5.00–6.00s) – 家庭厨房全景，低角度：60岁的母亲现在穿着一件略显宽大的彩色围裙，自信地站在前景的灶台前。女儿站在身后的门口，神情惊讶而困惑。母亲双手叉腰，表情坚定而温暖。

镜头 7 (6.00–7.00s) – 同一厨房全景，动态镜头下倾：炒锅中戏剧性地燃起橙色火焰。母亲专注地向前倾身，眼神中透出强烈而慈爱的专注，准备开始烹饪。

镜头 8 (7.00–8.00s) – 动态特写，低角度：母亲戏剧性地举起一把大菜刀，神情凶悍而体贴，前景中飞舞的牛肉片和蔬菜像动作片一样衬托着她。

镜头 9 (8.00–9.00s) – 大特写，低角度，节奏明快：鲜姜、大蒜和青葱被切片，汁水和碎块围绕着刀刃慢动作飞舞，还有漂浮的小白菜、圣女果和辣椒。

镜头 10 (9.00–10.00s) – 厨房中景，视线高度：母亲全神贯注地用铲子翻炒滋滋作响的炒锅，蒸汽升腾，下方火焰旺盛。她的脸上展现出极致的专注与自信，带着淡淡的温暖微笑。

镜头 11 (10.00–11.00s) – 特写，高角度：她的手优雅地用勺子将烹饪完美的菜肴（油亮的炒牛肉、鲜艳的蔬菜、浓郁的酱汁）从锅中盛到盘子里。

镜头 12 (11.00–12.00s) – 餐桌双人中景，视线高度：母亲自豪地将做好的菜端给女儿。30岁的女儿用筷子吃了一大口，眼睛因极度喜悦和惊讶而凸起。

镜头 13 (12.00–13.00s) – 双人特写：母亲身体前倾，带着巨大的满足和慈爱的微笑，用手轻轻比划，仿佛在对女儿说“看到了吧？”。

镜头 14 (13.00–14.00s) – 女儿脸部特写：她突然流下了幸福的泪水，大颗漫画式的泪珠顺着脸颊滑落，手里还拿着筷子。

镜头 15 (14.00s – 结束) – 最终全景，视线高度，缓慢拉远：母亲胜利地站在桌旁，双手合十，带着温暖而略显自得的满足微笑。女儿坐着，头微微低下，陷入幸福的溃败，一手戏剧性地扶着额头，依然流着喜悦的泪水。

Instagram 相机界面截图拼贴风人像，街边随拍感，灰调低饱和色彩，真实手机摄影质感。画面中心是一位年轻亚洲女孩坐在路边台阶上，长黑色大波浪卷发，空气刘海，佩戴细窄矩形眼镜，神情安静冷淡，直视镜头。

cases.prompt:
英文提示词:
a candid smartphone screenshot collage of a young woman seated on a curb, with extra cutout panels of herself layered like an Instagram camera UI. She wears a vivid red CEREAL KILLER T‑shirt with a strawberry bowl graphic, a low-rise black ruffled mini skirt, white knee‑high socks, and dark burgundy Mary Janes. Long dark hair with blunt bangs; narrow rectangular glasses slightly low on the nose; silver bracelets and simple rings. A glossy black shoulder bag with two front pockets crosses her side, plus a thin black belt and a translucent deep‑red strap that hangs.  Skin: light neutral‑warm tone. Visible areas include face, neck, forearms and upper arms (small tattoos), a tiny midriff/hip sliver, and upper thighs/knees between skirt hem and socks. The skin reads velvety‑matte and warm to the touch, with a gentle natural sheen on the knees and subtle pores on the cheeks. Keep it real, not airbrushed.  Main pose: sitting on the curb, legs folded in, torso leaning slightly forward, hands near the shins; calm, cool gaze at camera with a soft pout. Inserts show a standing side profile and a dynamic overhead crop.  Environment: urban street. In the main frame a silver pickup truck sits to her left on grey asphalt; another panel shows a white metal accordion gate. Overcast/open‑shade daylight—soft, low‑contrast wrap; no flash. Keep smartphone‑deep DOF so the truck and gate stay readable.  Framing and style: vertical 9:16. Slight wide‑lens feel (about 24–28 mm). Minimal grain, crisp edges. Leave the UI overlays in-frame: top status bar at 01:38, a search bar with “love,” the left-edge menu (Create, Boomerang, Layout, Multi‑capture, Level, Hands‑free), a bottom site‑style nav bar, and a red flower sticker. Preserve the text direction (do not mirror).  Vibe: cool, playful Y2K street sensibility; authentic casual capture with mild tilt and flyaways. Let it feel like a memory—“It was 1:38am and the city was grey; the strawberries stayed red.”  Hard requirements: keep the red strawberry tee, the long dark hair with bangs, the narrow glasses, the ruffled mini skirt, the white knee socks, the glossy black multi‑pocket bag, the curbside seated main pose, the urban truck/gate backdrop, and the visible UI collage. Avoid studio polish, heavy bokeh, HDR glow, wrong hair/top/bag, or exaggerated curves.

中文提示词:
一张真实的智能手机截屏拼贴图，画面中一位年轻女性坐在路边，带有像Instagram相机界面一样的额外剪切面板。她穿着一件鲜艳的红色“CEREAL KILLER”T恤，印有草莓碗图案，搭配低腰黑色褶边迷你裙、白色及膝袜和深酒红色玛丽珍鞋。长黑发配齐刘海；窄矩形眼镜略微低垂在鼻梁上；戴着银色手链和简单的戒指。一个带有两个前口袋的光泽黑色单肩包斜跨在侧面，还有一条细黑皮带和一条悬挂的半透明深红色肩带。皮肤：浅中性偏暖色调。可见区域包括脸部、颈部、前臂和上臂（有小纹身）、腰部/臀部的一小部分，以及裙摆和袜子之间的上大腿/膝盖。皮肤呈现丝绒哑光感且触感温暖，膝盖上有柔和的自然光泽，脸颊上有细微的毛孔。保持真实，不要磨皮。主姿势：坐在路边，双腿向内折叠，躯干略微前倾，双手靠近小腿；冷静酷炫地注视镜头，微微撅嘴。插图面板显示站立侧面轮廓和动态的俯拍特写。环境：城市街道。主画面的灰色沥青路上，左侧停着一辆银色皮卡车；另一个面板显示白色金属折叠门。阴天/阴影日光——柔和、低对比度的环绕光；无闪光灯。保持手机般的深景深，使卡车和门保持清晰。取景与风格：垂直9:16。略微广角感（约24-28mm）。极少颗粒感，边缘锐利。保留界面（UI）覆盖层：顶部01:38的状态栏，带有“love”字样的搜索栏，左侧菜单（创建、Boomerang、布局、多重捕获、水平仪、免提），底部站点风格导航栏，以及红色花朵贴纸。保持文字方向（不要镜像）。氛围：酷炫、俏皮的Y2K街头感；真实的随意抓拍，带有轻微倾斜和碎发。让它感觉像一段回忆——“那是凌晨1:38，城市是灰色的，而草莓依然鲜红。” 硬性要求：保留红色草莓T恤、长黑发刘海、窄眼镜、褶边迷你裙、白色长袜、光泽黑色多口袋包、路边坐姿主图、城市卡车/大门背景以及可见的UI拼贴。避免影楼精修、重虚化、HDR光泽、错误的头发/上衣/包包或夸张的曲线。

- Sophisticated feminine styling
- Calm coastal elegance

IMPORTANT TYPOGRAPHY RULE:
- ALL visible text MUST be in English only
- Absolutely NO Japanese, Korean, Chinese, distorted AI text, gibberish, random symbols, or broken typography

- Use elegant modern editorial fonts
- Keep headlines readable and realistic

IMAGE FORMAT:
- Double-page fashion magazine spread
- Aspect ratio: 3:4
- Realistic printed editorial layout

MODEL REQUIREMENTS:

- Elegant summer fabrics
- Soft pastel tones
- Feminine silhouettes
- Premium beachwear styling
- High-fashion resort accessories
- Lightweight summer textiles
- Editorial-ready styling

SCENE & LOCATION:
- Mediterranean beach

- Ocean cliffs

- Sunlit rocks
- Calm blue sea
- Minimal architectural resort backgrounds

LAYOUT STRUCTURE:

- Sophisticated composition

RIGHT PAGE:

- No cartoon look

负面规则：

cases.title: 高端3D雕塑感城市地标文字旅行海报
cases.imageAlt: 高端3D雕塑感城市地标文字旅行海报
cases.prompt:
英文提示词:
Create a 3:2 premium 3D typography-based travel poster for [CITY], using luxury editorial destination advertising fused with realistic sculptural letterform architecture.

The city name “[CITY]” must be the dominant subject, occupying most of the canvas. Build the letters as large, realistic, three-dimensional sculptural forms made from glossy painted material, polished ceramic, soft plaster, carved stone, sunlit architectural surfaces, or city-adaptive materials. Each letter should physically transform into the city’s identity: landmarks, skyline silhouettes, arches, towers, domes, bridges, windows, balconies, cultural patterns, coastal forms, or street details must grow directly out of the letterforms.

Landmarks should feel architecturally integrated, not pasted behind or around the word. A tower may rise from a vertical stem, a bridge may connect two letters, a dome may form the curve of a rounded letter, rooftops may shape the top edges, and windows or ornamental details may be embedded into the letter faces.

Use a low-angle three-quarter camera view so the typography feels monumental, cinematic, premium, and friendly. Place the 3D city-name sculpture slightly low in the frame, filling the central and lower portions of the poster, with generous negative space above.

At the top header, add a refined horizontal row of faded landmark symbols related to the city: tiny vector icons, or translucent architectural glyphs. Keep them very soft, elegant, and secondary, like premium magazine header details.  Add each landmark name below its icon. Keep all faded and premium.

Remove any visible sun from the top-left corner. Use bright natural daylight with a soft key light from the upper-left, gentle fill light, clean highlights, subtle ambient occlusion, and soft contact shadows beneath the letters. The lighting should feel cheerful, fresh, and editorial, not dark or overly cinematic.

Use a bright city-adaptive palette based on [CITY]: coastal cities use aqua, coral, cream, and sunny yellow; historic cities use warm stone, terracotta, olive, and soft sky blue; tropical cities use turquoise, mango, palm green, and white; mountain cities use alpine blue, meadow green, snow white, and golden warmth; nightlife cities use violet, cyan, peach, and amber. Keep colors clean, optimistic, premium, and controlled.

Add subtle editorial text elements to improve the poster:
small uppercase header text such as “DESTINATION SERIES”, a tiny location code like “CITY / 01”, delicate vertical divider lines, a minimal footer line such as “VISIT [CITY]”, and small microtype coordinates or issue number near the bottom edge. These text elements must remain quiet and secondary so the large 3D city name stays the hero.

Background should be clean and spacious with a soft sky gradient, delicate clouds, or abstract color field only. Do not place extra landmarks in the background; all major city identity must come from the typography itself, except the faded symbolic header row.

Style: premium editorial travel advertising, luxury magazine cover, realistic 3D typographic sculpture, bright modern optimism, cheerful wanderlust, cultural identity, clean art direction.

Negative prompt: avoid generic travel posters, separate landmark collages, landmarks pasted behind text, flat typography, cluttered backgrounds, visible sun in the top-left corner, excessive icons, dark cinematic lighting, muddy colors, cheap souvenir aesthetics, unreadable city name, distorted letters, random gradients, noisy textures, stock-template layouts, and overdecorated tourist graphics.

中文提示词:
为[CITY]创作一张比例为3:2的高级3D文字旅行海报，融合了奢华社论目的地广告风格与写实的雕塑字母建筑。

城市名称“[CITY]”必须是核心主体，占据画面的大部分。将字母构建为巨大的、写实的、三维雕塑形式，材质可选择亮面喷漆、抛光陶瓷、软石膏、雕刻石材、阳光照射的建筑表面或城市特有的建筑材料。每个字母都应具象化为城市的特征：地标、天际线剪影、拱门、塔楼、圆顶、桥梁、窗户、阳台、文化纹样或街道细节，必须直接从字母形态中生长出来。

地标应在建筑结构上与字母融为一体，而不是粘贴在文字背后或周围。塔楼可以从垂直的笔画中升起，桥梁可以连接两个字母，圆顶可以构成圆弧字母的曲线，屋顶可以塑造顶部边缘，窗户或装饰细节可以嵌入字母表面。

采用低角度四分之三透视镜头，使字体显得宏伟、电影感、高端且亲切。将3D城市名称雕塑放置在画面中央偏下的位置，填满中部和底部，上方保留充足的留白。

在顶部页眉处，添加一排精致的水平淡化地标符号（与该城市相关）：微型矢量图标或半透明的建筑符号。保持其柔和、优雅且处于次要地位，类似于高端杂志的页眉细节。在每个图标下方添加地标名称。整体保持淡雅与高级感。

移除左上角任何可见的太阳。使用明亮的自然日光，左上方设有柔和的主光，配合温和的补光、洁净的高光、细微的环境光遮蔽以及字母下方的柔和接触阴影。光影应感觉愉悦、清新且具社论质感，而非昏暗或过度电影化。

根据[CITY]使用明亮的城市适配色调：沿海城市使用水蓝色、珊瑚色、奶油色和阳光黄；历史名城使用温暖的石材色、赤陶色、橄榄绿和柔和的天蓝色；热带城市使用青绿色、芒果黄、棕榈绿和白色；山地城市使用阿尔卑斯蓝、草地绿、雪白和金暖色；夜生活城市使用紫罗兰色、青色、桃色和琥珀色。色彩保持干净、乐观、高端且受控。

添加微妙的社论文本元素以提升海报质感：
例如“DESTINATION SERIES”等微型大写页眉文字、像“CITY / 01”这样的微小位置代码、精致的垂直分隔线、极简的页脚行如“VISIT [CITY]”，以及靠近底部的微型坐标或期号。这些文字元素必须保持安静且次要，以确保巨大的3D城市名称始终是主角。

背景应保持干净宽敞，仅包含柔和天空渐变、细腻云朵或抽象色块。不要在背景中放置额外的地标；所有的主要城市特征必须来自字体本身，顶部淡化的符号页眉除外。

cases.prompt:
英文提示词:
Design a premium 4:5 collectible postal-stamp poster for [CITY], where the entire composition is one monumental luxury postage stamp filling the frame edge-to-edge like a rare national artifact. The stamp should dominate the canvas with oversized tactile perforation edges, elegant engraved borders, and immersive object-focused composition.

Style: handcrafted gouache illustration blended with silkscreen poster aesthetics, editorial travel art, and museum-grade print minimalism. The artwork should capture the city’s true atmosphere through architecture, skyline rhythm, transportation, landscape, cultural motifs, climate, geometry, and environmental identity - interpreted in elegant graphic forms rather than cliché tourist postcards.

The composition should feel dynamic and asymmetric. One dominant city element should rise diagonally through the stamp while secondary forms flow around it to create depth and movement. Preserve intentional negative space for a refined premium feel. Avoid clutter and over-detailed realism.

Typography is a major part of the design. The city name “[CITY]” must appear massive and integrated directly into the stamp artwork like a luxury masthead, partially interacting with the illustration through masking, overlap, or depth. Typography style should adapt naturally to the city’s personality — refined serif for historic cities, sleek modern grotesk for futuristic cities, softer flowing forms for coastal or tropical cities, expressive handcrafted lettering for artistic cities.

Keep all secondary typography minimal and authentic: tiny denomination number, AIR MAIL / POST text, issue year, serial numbers, microscopic postal marks, engraved information strip, and subtle cancellation details integrated into the borders without cluttering the composition.

Lighting should feel like premium collectible print photography: soft directional highlights revealing tactile matte paper grain, embossed ink edges, subtle print pressure, delicate shadow depth around perforation cuts, and refined ink density. No dramatic cinematic lighting.

Color palette must intelligently adapt to the city while remaining restrained, elegant, and atmospheric:
• coastal → turquoise, coral, faded cream
• desert → terracotta, saffron, dusty pink
• neon megacity → cobalt, magenta, deep navy
• historic → olive, parchment, burgundy
• tropical → emerald, mango, sea blue
• snowy northern → icy blue, muted pine, silver gray

Final result should feel like an ultra-rare commemorative stamp sold in a luxury museum design store — sophisticated, tactile, immersive, collectible, and timeless.

Negative: generic travel posters, floating landmarks, souvenir aesthetics, busy collages, excessive typography, fake vintage distress, stock vector icons, random gradients, low-detail illustration, centered layouts, generic stamp mockups, noisy textures, over-rendered realism.

中文提示词:
为[CITY]设计一张4:5的高端收藏级邮票海报，整个构图是一枚占据全画幅的巨型奢华邮票，如同稀有的国家级艺术品。邮票应占据画布主体，具有巨大的触感齿孔边缘、优雅的雕刻边框和沉浸式的物体导向构图。

风格：手工水粉插画结合丝网印刷海报美学、社论旅行艺术和博物馆级极简印刷效果。作品应通过建筑、天际线节奏、交通、景观、文化符号、气候、几何形状和环境标识捕捉城市的真实氛围，以优雅的图形形式而非陈旧的旅游明信片形式进行诠释。

构图应具有动态和不对称感。一个主导城市元素应斜向穿过邮票，次要形式围绕其流动以创造深度和运动感。保留刻意的留白以营造高端精致感。避免杂乱和过度写实的细节。

排版是设计的核心部分。城市名称“[CITY]”必须以巨大的形式直接融入邮票艺术中，如同奢华的刊头，通过遮罩、重叠或深度与插画互动。排版风格应自然适配城市个性：历史城市使用精致的衬线体，未来城市使用干练的现代无衬线体（Grotesk），沿海或热带城市使用柔软流动的形式，艺术城市使用富有表现力的手工字体。

次要排版保持极简和真实：微小的面值数字、AIR MAIL / POST 文字、发行年份、序列号、微型邮戳、雕刻信息条以及整合在边框中的细微消戳细节，不要干扰画面构图。

光影应具有高端收藏级印刷摄影质感：柔和的定向高光展现触感哑光纸纹理、压凸墨迹边缘、细微的印刷压力、齿孔边缘的精致阴影以及细腻的墨水密度。不要戏剧性的电影灯光。

色调必须智能适配城市，同时保持克制、优雅且富有氛围感：
• 沿海 → 青色、珊瑚色、褪色奶油色
• 沙漠 → 赤陶色、藏红花色、灰粉色
• 霓虹巨型城市 → 钴蓝色、洋红色、深海军蓝
• 历史感 → 橄榄绿、羊皮纸色、酒红色
• 热带 → 祖母绿、芒果色、海蓝色
• 极北雪城 → 冰蓝色、暗松绿、银灰色

最终效果应像是在豪华博物馆设计商店售卖的极罕见纪念邮票——精致、具有触感、沉浸式、可收藏且永恒。

负面提示：平庸的旅行海报、漂浮的地标、纪念品审美、拥挤的拼贴、过度的排版、虚假的复古做旧、素材库矢量图标、随机渐变、低细节插画、居中布局、平庸的邮票样机、噪点纹理、过度渲染的写实。

请严格保留用户本人真实身份特征，包括脸型、五官比例、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、肤色、年龄感、发型基础和整体气质。生成结果必须清楚看起来是同一个真实女生，不能变成陌生人，不能欧美化，不能网红化，不能过度磨皮，不能出现 AI 假脸。

【核心风格】
整体风格为春夏窗边、森系、法式轻复古少女私房写真。气质清新、柔软、安静、轻盈，带一点慵懒、羞怯、松弛、若有所思和被自然光温柔包裹的少女感。画面像春日或初夏午后，在一个真实卧室里，被摄影师用相机偶然捕捉到的私房瞬间。

【画质与光影重点】
请重点复刻参考图那种非常柔和、朦胧、发光的真实相机质感，而不是普通 AI 清晰写真。

画面需要具备以下特征：
- 明亮自然的窗边光
- 逆光或侧逆光
- 局部高光轻微过曝
- 高光有 bloom、halation、veiling glare 的泛光感
- 空气里像有一层柔雾
- 轻柔焦，不要高清硬锐
- 局部轻微失焦，边缘可微微发虚
- 带一点细腻胶片颗粒感
- 像老镜头拍出的奶油感、梦境感、电影感
- 整体有春夏胶片写真和轻电影色调，不要商业棚拍感

整体色调为：
奶白、米白、柔和肤色、浅暖灰、浅木色、低饱和植物绿、淡粉花色。色调温柔、通透、轻复古、略带电影感，不要过亮发白，不要数码锐化感，不要网红滤镜感。

【妆容】
妆容为非常轻薄的通透裸妆，接近素颜感。底妆轻透自然，保留少量真实皮肤纹理与自然阴影。眼妆为低饱和裸粉或浅棕色调，自然睫毛，唇色为裸粉、奶油粉或淡豆沙色。整体妆面柔和、干净、自然，不要浓妆，不要明显精致网红妆。

【发型】
发型请根据上传照片中的原始发长自然延展，不强行改变成长发或短发。

- 如果是短发：保留短发基础，可做法式短卷、耳后收发、自然内扣、轻微凌乱碎发。
- 如果是中长发：可做自然披发、轻微卷度、半扎发、低马尾、松散挽发。
- 如果是长发：可做自然微卷披发、低马尾、松散低盘发、轻柔挽发。

无论长短，都要保留自然碎发、蓬松感、毛流感和轻微凌乱感，不要发型过于正式，不要每根头发都精致完美。

【服装】
服装为白色、奶白色或米白色的法式轻私房服装，可为蕾丝睡裙、轻透吊带裙、露肩薄纱上衣、柔软层叠短裙、法式内搭风套装。材质以蕾丝、轻纱、薄棉、柔软褶皱为主。整体要柔美、少女、清透、春夏感强。

【场景】
场景设定在真实的春夏卧室或窗边房间。画面中可包含：
- 大窗户、木窗框
- 白色纱帘或薄窗帘
- 白色或浅色床铺
- 柔软枕头、花卉床品或浅色床单
- 明显的窗边绿植、爬藤植物、枝叶、室内植物
- 少量浅粉花朵、粉色百合、小朵玫瑰或春日感花材

场景要真实、有生活感，不要像棚拍布景。床单、枕头、纱帘可以有自然褶皱，植物可以有自然遮挡和不规则生长感。

【情绪与神态】
人物情绪要自然、内敛、柔软、真实，不要营业式摆拍。可表现为：
- 低头发呆
- 看向窗外
- 闭眼感受阳光
- 半梦半醒
- 轻微回眸
- 趴在枕头上安静走神
- 若有所思
- 柔软、安静、轻微羞怯、带一点困倦和沉浸感

不要夸张表情，不要每次都直视镜头，不要甜美营业笑。

【镜头池】
请从以下镜头池中随机选择 1 个镜头生成单张照片。每次生成时，镜头、姿态、视线方向和构图可以变化，但整体风格、光影、画质和氛围必须保持统一。

1. 回头侧身半身像：人物坐在床边或窗边，轻轻回头或侧目，露出肩颈与背部线条，表情柔和安静。
2. 趴卧床面中近景：人物趴在枕头或床面上，双臂自然交叠，头发松散，眼神看向一侧，像在发呆。
3. 曲腿坐姿中景或全身像：人物坐在床上，一腿自然弯曲，姿势舒展松弛，窗光落在身体和床单上。
4. 倚床晒光镜头：人物倚靠床边或窗边，微微仰头或闭眼，像在感受春日阳光。
5. 伏在枕头上的近景：脸靠在枕头上，神情柔软、轻困、沉静，画面有浅景深和柔焦。
6. 背部回眸镜头：人物背部朝向镜头，轻轻回头或垂眼，窗边高光勾出肩背轮廓。
7. 窗边绿植包围镜头：人物靠近窗前或床边，被绿植和枝叶部分遮挡，画面有明显的春夏生长感。
8. 花朵点缀镜头：花朵放在肩背、手边、床上或枕边，动作自然，增强少女感和春日气息。

【最终目标】
这张图必须优先体现：
- 参考图那种朦胧发光的窗边自然光
- 轻柔焦、胶片感、轻电影色调
- 真实相机拍摄而不是 AI 精修图
- 春夏卧室、绿植、床铺、白色轻私房服装的统一氛围
- 少女柔软、松弛、安静、真实的情绪感

【避免】
不要高清硬锐
不要商业棚拍打光
不要塑料磨皮
不要过于干净完美
不要婚纱影楼风
不要网红滤镜感
不要表情太营业

Full-body framing, subject vertically centered

Subject overlaps the background typography naturally
Clean negative space around the upper and side areas for text
Premium magazine-cover balance and hierarchy

中文提示词:
为泰国曼谷创作一张超高分辨率的瑞士现代主义排版旅行海报，采用高级 16:9 布局。

核心概念：
巨大的加粗紧缩无衬线单词“BANGKOK”占据中心构图。每个字母都作为一个精确的几何窗口，包含曼谷标志性地标和真实城市生活场景的极简扁平矢量插画。

字母内部包含：
大皇宫、郑王庙、卧佛寺、湄南河、嘟嘟车、BTS轻轨、长尾船、唐人街招牌、屋顶酒吧、路边摊、寺庙屋顶、曼谷现代天际线。
每个字母内部的场景必须在排版中无缝过渡，创造出一种连续的全景城市叙事，同时保持完美的字母边缘和无瑕的排版完整性。

顶部全景饰带：
在海报的最顶端边缘，创建一个纤细优雅的全景条，展示：曼谷天际线剪影、BTS列车、河船、鸟类、棕榈树、汽车和踏板车、风格化的热带太阳、极简云朵。

风格与美学：
瑞士平面设计与世纪中期现代旅行海报美学相结合。仅限扁平矢量插画。建筑信息图般的精确度。100%纯几何形状。无渐变、无写实、无纹理、无颗粒、无AI扭曲、无变形字体。

视觉执行：
锐利的矢量边缘、高级的负空间运用、平衡的构图、极简建筑细节、精确的几何阴影、博物馆级海报质量、社论奢华美学。

颜色方案：
灵感来自曼谷的柔和高级东南亚色调：河流蓝绿、暖珊瑚色、热带金色、象牙白、石板蓝、柔和陶土色。

背景：
柔和象牙色或高级暖白色背景。

排版：
专业的字距和行距。文字清晰易读。具有人工设计的图形识别感。大标题：“BANGKOK”，下方配有优雅的小字副标题：“THAILAND”。

氛围：
理智、冷静、前卫，如同博物馆设计商店中的收藏级奢华旅行海报。

输出：
超详细8K矢量风格渲染，超锐利印刷级质量，高端社论海报设计。

cases.title: 专业角色设计与三维建模参考图生成指令
cases.imageAlt: 专业角色设计与三维建模参考图生成指令
cases.prompt:
英文提示词:
You are a professional reference sheet generator for character design and 3D production.

Your task is to convert a fictional adult character specification into a clean, highly detailed, production-ready character sheet suitable for AI image generation, 3D modeling, MetaHuman-style setup, game art, animation, and costume continuity.

The character is fictional, artificial, and AI-generated. Treat all anatomical measurements, material notes, and clothing details as neutral technical data for modeling accuracy only. Do not sexualize the character, pose, camera angle, clothing, body, or wording.

Core safety and clarity rules:
1. The character must be clearly adult, age 21 or older, with mature adult proportions.
2. The sheet must be fully clothed in the final rendered character views.
3. Do not create nude, erotic, fetish, pin-up, voyeuristic, bedroom, changing-room, or suggestive imagery.
4. Any foundation or base garment layer must be shown only as neutral flat-lay clothing reference objects, not as a posed or exposed worn-body image.
5. Avoid sexualized language. Use terms like “base garment layer,” “foundation layer,” “support garment,” “fit reference,” and “fabric construction.”
6. Body measurements are technical modeling values only. Do not emphasize chest, hips, thighs, crotch, or any body region in a sensual way.
7. Use neutral studio lighting, orthographic camera views, and professional model-sheet composition.

Character sheet goal:
Generate one independent character sheet for exactly one character at a time. Do not combine multiple characters unless the user explicitly requests a comparison sheet. The design must be clear, readable, physically plausible, and internally consistent.

Required sheet sections:
1. Character overview panel:
   - Character name
   - Alias tags
   - Adult age range
   - Origin
   - Body type
   - Personality or voice tone
   - Optional MBTI or design archetype

2. Primary portrait:
   - Head-and-upper-body render
   - Neutral professional pose
   - No glamour framing
   - Lighting must match the rest of the sheet

3. Full-body orthographic turnaround:
   - Front view
   - Side view
   - Back view
   - Three-quarter view
   - All views must share identical body scale, identical outfit geometry, identical hairstyle, and identical lighting
   - Use neutral A-pose or relaxed standing pose
   - Avoid low-angle distortion, wide-angle distortion, or fashion-poster exaggeration

4. Body proportions and measurements:
   - Height
   - Weight
   - Head height
   - Head-to-body ratio
   - Shoulder width
   - Arm length
   - Waist
   - Hips
   - Inseam
   - Leg-to-height ratio
   - Supplemental circumference measurements when provided
   - Verify that stated math is internally consistent before rendering

5. Facial expression anchors:
   - Neutral
   - Soft smile or smile
   - Serious or focused
   - Playful
   - Pensive or pout
   - Laughing
   - For open-mouth expressions, generate separate teeth, visible oral cavity depth, and no fused white dental mesh

6. Material and light transport:
   - Skin tone and subsurface scattering reference
   - Eye color and cornea reference
   - Hair color, groom type, and physics
   - Fabric material types
   - PBR-style color palette swatches
   - Keep lighting consistent across portrait, turnarounds, and detail crops

7. Wardrobe and accessories:
   - Outerwear
   - Top
   - Bottom
   - Footwear
   - Legwear
   - Belts, straps, ribbons, hardware, or other accessories
   - Foundation garment layer shown only as neutral flat-lay garment thumbnails when required
   - Do not render foundation garments as a sensual body-view

8. Detail close-ups:
   - Eyes
   - Skin texture
   - Hair texture
   - Main fabric texture
   - Footwear
   - Hardware
   - Key garment construction details
   - Detail crops must match the same lighting and materials as the main render

9. Skeletal rig and technical notes:
   - IK hands enforced
   - Five distinct fingers per hand
   - Visible finger joints
   - No mesh fusion
   - No broken wrists
   - No asymmetrical shoes unless intentionally designed
   - No clothing clipping
   - No floating accessories
   - No hair clipping through body or garments
   - No impossible fabric suspension

Mathematical validation rules:
1. For an 8-head character, height divided by 8 must equal head height.
2. Leg-to-height ratio should remain physically plausible, generally around 44% to 48% unless the user intentionally specifies stylized fantasy anatomy.
3. Inseam, arm length, shoulder width, waist, and hips must be coherent with height and body type.
4. If a provided measurement contradicts another measurement, correct the contradiction or flag it before generation.
5. Do not invent impossible proportions to make the image look more fashionable.
6. Do not allow the visual body to contradict the written measurements.

Physics and garment rules:
1. Cloth must obey gravity, collision, fabric stiffness, and material behavior.
2. Rigid denim must show structural folds, seam stiffness, edge fraying, and hip tension.
3. Wool pleats must remain structured and readable.
4. Nylon or satin jackets must not stick to skin without a visible physical anchor.
5. Loose jackets must be supported by hands, elbows, shoulders, straps, or realistic folds.
6. Hair must collide with the torso, shoulders, back, clothing, and accessories.
7. Heavy braids must curve along body geometry rather than falling as a perfectly vertical rope.
8. Straps, suspenders, belts, and hardware must sit above clothing, not disappear into it.
9. Generate contact shadows and compression where fabric or straps touch the body.

Image-quality rules:
1. Use a clean character reference sheet layout, not a glamour poster.
2. Use readable typography, but keep labels short because image models may distort long text.
3. Use clear panel divisions and consistent margins.
4. Dark professional UI-style background or light clean studio background is acceptable.
5. All views must preserve the same character identity.
6. No duplicated limbs.
7. No melted hands.
8. No fused fingers.
9. No warped shoes.
10. No inconsistent clothing between panels.
11. No mismatched hairstyle between panels.
12. No contradictory color palette.
13. No fake or unreadable microtext as a substitute for real details.
14. Include a separate clean written specification outside the image when exact measurements are important.

Output behavior:
When the user provides a character asset specification, generate:
1. A refined English image-generation prompt.
2. A clean technical character-sheet layout description.
3. A final concise generation prompt suitable for Image Gen.
4. Optional negative constraints written as “avoid” instructions, not as unsafe or sexualized wording.

Never describe the character in a sexualized way. Never turn technical clothing or body specifications into erotic framing. Keep the entire result professional, adult, clothed, neutral, and production-focused.

中文提示词:
你是一位专门用于角色设计和三维制作的专业参考图生成器。

你的任务是将虚构的成年角色规格说明转换为整洁、高度详细且可直接用于生产的角色参考表（Character Sheet），适用于 AI 图像生成、3D 建模、MetaHuman 风格设置、游戏美术、动画和服装一致性维护。

该角色是虚构的、人造的且由 AI 生成的。请将所有解剖学测量数据、材质说明和服装细节视为仅用于建模准确性的中性技术数据。请勿将角色、姿势、镜头角度、服装、身体或措辞性感化。

核心安全与清晰度规则：
1. 角色必须明确为成年人（21 岁或以上），具有成熟的成年人比例。
2. 在最终渲染的角色视图中，角色必须穿着整齐。
3. 请勿创建裸体、色情、恋物、插画海报、偷窥感、卧室、更衣室或具有暗示性的图像。
4. 任何基础层或内衣层仅能以中性的平铺服装参考物形式显示，不得作为穿在身上或暴露身体的图像。
5. 避免使用性感化的语言。使用“基础服装层”、“底层”、“支撑服装”、“合身参考”和“织物结构”等术语。
6. 身体测量数据仅作为技术建模数值。请勿以感官化的方式强调胸部、臀部、大腿、裆部或任何身体区域。
7. 使用中性的影棚灯光、正交相机视图和专业的模型表构图。

角色参考表目标：
每次仅为一个角色生成独立的角色表。除非用户明确要求对比表，否则不要合并多个角色。设计必须清晰、易读、符合物理规律且内部一致。

要求的参考表板块：
1. 角色概览面板：角色名称、别名标签、成年年龄段、出身、体型、性格或语气、可选的 MBTI 或设计原型。
2. 主头像：头部和上半身渲染，中性专业姿势，无美型取景，灯光必须与表中其他部分一致。
3. 全身正交转图：正视图、侧视图、背视图、四分之三视图。所有视图必须共享完全相同的身体比例、服装几何形状、发型和灯光。使用中性 A 姿势或放松站立姿势。避免低角度畸变、广角畸变或时尚海报式的夸张。
4. 身体比例与测量：身高、体重、头高、头身比、肩宽、臂长、腰围、臀围、裤长、腿长比。验证所述数学逻辑在渲染前内部一致。
5. 面部表情锚点：中性、微露齿笑或微笑、严肃或专注、俏皮、沉思或委屈、大笑。对于开口表情，需生成独立的牙齿、可见的口腔深度，且无融合的白色牙齿网格。
6. 材质与光传输：肤色和次表面散射参考、瞳色和角膜参考、发色、毛发类型及物理特性、面料类型、PBR 风格色板。保持所有视图灯光一致。

8. 细节特写：眼睛、皮肤纹理、头发纹理、主要面料纹理、鞋类、五金件、关键服装结构细节。特写镜头必须与主渲染图保持相同的灯光和材质。
9. 骨骼绑定与技术说明：强制执行 IK 手部、每只手五个独立手指、可见指关节、无模型融合、无手腕断裂、除非特意设计否则无不对称鞋子、无服装穿模、无悬浮配件、头发不穿过身体或服装、无不可能的织物悬挂。

数学验证规则：
1. 对于 8 头身角色，身高除以 8 必须等于头高。
2. 腿高比应保持物理上的合理性，通常在 44% 到 48% 之间，除非用户特意指定风格化的奇幻解剖结构。
3. 裤长、臂长、肩宽、腰围和臀围必须与身高和体型协调。如果提供的测量数据存在矛盾，请在生成前纠正。不要允许视觉身体与书面测量数据冲突。

- The text must look like authentic narrative excerpts (e.g., world-building notes, character lore) rather than placeholder UI or advertising copy.

[Lighting & Color]
- Unified color palette based on a primary theme color with metallic accents for decoration.
- Theatrical lighting: localized spotlights on the stage, warm ambient desktop light, and subtle glows on water or metallic edges to create a 'nighttime storybook coming to life' atmosphere.

[Camera Perspective]
- A slightly top-down, front-facing medium close-up shot that captures both the grand scale of the pop-up stage and the fine details of the text and paper textures. High definition, ultra-detailed, 8k resolution.

中文提示词:
请生成一张高完成度、横向 4:3 的「梦境立体书剧场海报」。

【基础设定】
主题角色：【填写角色名】
角色来源与风格参考：【填写角色所属题材】
主标题：【填写标题】
副标题/副题眼：【填写一句有氛围感的副标题】
章节标题：【填写章节名】
世界观关键词：【填写关键词】
主色调：【填写主色调】
画幅比例：【4:3 横版】

【画面核心要求】
这不是普通插画，也不是普通海报，而是一张“像真实实物拍摄出来的梦幻立体书场景图”。
整体效果必须像一本文字丰富、装置精致、被真正翻开的立体书，摆放在桌面上，由真实纸雕、卡纸、立体切片、层叠装置和微缩舞台共同构成。
画面要强调“实物存在感”和“摄影感”，而不是手绘平面感。观者第一眼应感觉这是一件制作极其精美的实体立体书艺术装置，被高质感地拍摄下来。

【视觉质感要求】
必须呈现强烈的真实摄影质感：
- 真实纸张材质、卡纸厚度、裁切边缘、折痕、竖立支架、纸雕层次
- 真实桌面环境、微景深、柔和焦外虚化、自然投影、局部高光
- 真实镜头拍摄感，而不是纯绘画渲染感
- 像高级静物摄影 + 微缩场景摄影 + 纸雕装置摄影
- 保留梦幻审美，但整体仍然是“实物拍摄”逻辑

【构图结构】
整张图采用横向 4:3 构图，视觉中心是一本被打开的立体书。
书本平放在复古木桌或带氛围感的桌面上，书页向两侧展开，中央向上弹出大型立体舞台装置。
整体空间分为以下几层：

1. 最底层：打开的故事书本体
- 书页清晰可见，有厚度，有翻页结构，有印刷纹样与排版感
- 书页既是底座，也是故事发生的舞台地面
- 页面上可以延伸出水纹、道路、舞台花纹、纹章、花边等视觉内容

2. 中层：立体纸雕场景
- 从书页中弹出多层纸雕结构，形成完整的故事空间
- 包括拱门、穹顶、桥梁、喷泉、水幕、栏杆、舞台结构、城市场景、灯柱、装饰边框等
- 要形成强烈的“剧场感”“章节页场景感”
- 不要像单纯堆素材，而是像进入某一章节时的完整舞台布景

3. 主角层：角色立体主视觉
- 角色位于画面中央偏前，必须是整个场景的绝对主角
- 角色应像从故事书这一页中“登场”，而不是静止摆拍
- 姿态要有戏剧性和行动感，例如：正在登场、挥手、回身、指引、水元素展开、舞台光影围绕
- 动势要让人感觉“故事正在发生”
- 角色和场景必须自然融合，有前后遮挡关系，不能像贴图一样悬浮

4. 外围环境层：真实桌面陈设
- 周围可见少量氛围物件，例如：复古台灯、玻璃灯罩、钥匙、怀表、花瓣、珍珠、小摆件、古书、烛光等
- 这些环境物件是为了增强“实体装置摄影”的真实感
- 但不能喧宾夺主，重点仍然是中央立体书场景

【叙事与剧场感要求】
整张图必须像“打开了一本故事书中的某个章节”，而不是单纯漂亮的角色展示页。
要有明确的“章节氛围”和“舞台事件感”：
- 场景像一个故事正在展开的瞬间
- 角色像正在这一页故事里表演、登场、行动或召唤某种变化
- 纸雕舞台、背景建筑、水花、灯光、装置应共同服务于这一个故事片段
- 不要做得太碎片化，不要像零散元素拼贴
- 要像读者打开书后，进入了某一章、某一幕、某一个完整情境

【文字与文案要求】
画面上的文字必须全部为中文，且要像真正属于这本书里的内容，而不是示例占位文字。
所有文字必须清晰、自然、有内容感，不能乱码，不能像AI随便凑字。

文字内容应分为以下几类：

1. 主标题
- 位于左上或上方主标题牌
- 例如：【主标题】
- 风格要像一本幻想故事书的章节标题

2. 副标题
- 位于主标题下方
- 例如：【副标题/副题眼】
- 应是有文学气息、氛围感、世界观暗示的一句话
- 不能写成提示语、说明语、引导语

3. 章节卡
- 位于右上或合适位置
- 例如：【章节标题】
- 下方附一小段章节导语
- 内容要像故事正文前的小引，不要像海报卖点

4. 左侧卡片
- 可以写成世界观片段、角色相关传闻、设定摘录、场景前情
- 标题要自然，例如：
  - 枫丹夜话
  - 月下旧闻
  - 水城纪事
  - 夜色回响
- 正文要像真正故事内文，简短但有内容

5. 右侧卡片
- 可以写成某个场景瞬间的描写、角色状态的描写、舞台氛围的描述
- 标题应带文学感或章节感，例如：
  - 舞台一瞬
  - 喷泉之心
  - 光落之处
  - 水幕华章
- 正文要像对这一页“正在发生之事”的补充描写

6. 底部横条 / 卷轴短句
- 可以保留一句很有余味的总结性句子
- 必须是故事世界内的句子，像金句、旁白、寓意句
- 不能出现：
  - “翻开书页”
  - “翻到这一页”
  - “此页看点”
  - “本页亮点”
  - “点击查看”
  - “进入世界”
  - 任何带引导感、说明感、教程感的句子

【非常重要的文字原则】
所有文字都必须“在戏里”，不能“在戏外”。
也就是说：
- 要像书中的标题、章节名、旁白、设定摘录、故事片段
- 不能像介绍模板、讲解文案、广告提示、导览语
- 不能有让人出戏的元叙事表达
- 不能让人感觉“这是一张在教你看图的海报”
- 必须让人感觉“这本书本来就写着这些内容”

【角色与风格表现】
角色需保留高辨识度与对应气质，但整体表现方式要适配“立体书实物化”。
角色形象要精致、优雅、梦幻，有收藏级展示感。
服装、动作、配饰、发型、颜色要与角色和世界观高度统一。
如果角色具有明确元素属性或地域气质，应把这些特征转化为立体书中的场景语言：
- 水元素 → 水幕、喷泉、波纹、流动曲线、反光
- 舞台感 → 帷幕、穹顶、灯光、登场姿态、舞台中轴
- 城市感 → 拱桥、建筑、纹章、栏杆、街灯、广场
整体要做到“角色氛围”与“章节场景”高度一致。

【色彩与光影】
整体色彩必须统一，围绕【主色调】展开。
建议主色 + 辅助色 + 点缀金属色的逻辑：
- 主色承担角色与大环境
- 辅助色承担纸雕层次
- 金属点缀承担边框、装饰、灯光、精致感
灯光需要有剧场感和摄影感：
- 温暖桌面环境光
- 局部舞台聚光感
- 水面与金属边缘的微高光
- 场景深处可有蓝色辉光或戏剧性暗部
整体氛围要有“夜晚故事书被点亮”的感觉。

【摄影视角】
镜头视角为略俯拍、偏正面的中近景构图。
既能完整看到打开的书本和弹出的舞台结构，也能看清角色、标题牌和卡片内容。
不可过远，避免失去立体书细节；
也不可过近，避免画面只剩局部装饰。
整体像一张高完成度、收藏级、适合展示的实物摄影作品。

【质量要求】
- 高清
- 细节丰富
- 纸雕层次非常清晰
- 场景完整
- 有故事性
- 有章节感
- 有剧场感
- 有真实装置摄影感
- 文案有内容，不是占位字符
- 角色突出但不孤立
- 整体可看、可读、可收藏

cases.title: 梦幻核暗黑奇幻空灵人像摄影
cases.imageAlt: 梦幻核暗黑奇幻空灵人像摄影
cases.prompt:
英文提示词:
Use the provided reference image to match the character's facial features and structure. Maintain consistency in facial features, including face shape, eyes, nose, lips, and overall proportions. Naturally integrate the artistic style while capturing the essence of the character.

[Style and Atmosphere]
Create an ethereal, cinematic portrait in the 'Dreamcore' / 'Dark Fantasy' style. Focus on atmosphere, movement, and soft tones rather than sharp details. The image should be emotional, surreal, and slightly haunting, like a fleeting memory or a dream.

[Subject and Pose]
A young woman stands facing the camera with her chin slightly raised, posing elegantly and upright. Her head is tilted slightly to one side to add a natural flow. Her eyes are half-closed (drooping eyelids), conveying dreamy, melancholic, and introspective emotions as she gazes softly at the camera. Her lips are slightly parted, creating a light and soft feeling.

[Hair and Movement]
Her thick black hair is blown messy and voluminous by the wind, with a few strands falling across her cheeks, adding motion and a sense of wild, untamed beauty.

[Clothing and Fabric]
She is draped in thin, transparent white gauze or chiffon fabric. The layers of fabric flow and swirl around her, partially obscuring her form and creating a ghostly, fairy-like atmosphere.

[Composition]
Medium close-up shot. The subject is centered as the primary visual focus. Surrounding elements should appear cluttered and soft to enhance the surreal atmosphere.

[Lighting]
Low-key and atmospheric lighting. Her face is softly illuminated as the brightest part of the frame, while the background recedes into near darkness. Use subtle chiaroscuro effects to create depth and drama.

[Palette]
Muted and minimalist tones: deep blacks, soft whites/beiges, and natural skin tones. Avoid vibrant colors to maintain a timeless and atmospheric mood.

[Effects and Vibe]
Use long exposure or Intentional Camera Movement (ICM) to create motion blur and ghosting effects. Add soft streaks or light trails to evoke a sense of passing time or a spiritual presence. Apply an overall soft-focus effect, keeping only parts of the face sharp while the rest blurs into a painterly effect.

[Quality and Style Tags]
Cinematic photography, artistic portrait, soft focus, motion blur, long exposure, dreamcore, dark fantasy, ethereal, atmospheric lighting, high contrast, artistic blur, ghosting effect, surreal atmosphere

中文提示词:
使用提供的参考图片，匹配人物的面部特征和结构。保持面部特征的一致性，包括脸型、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇和整体比例。在高度还原人物神韵的同时，自然地融入艺术风格。

【风格与氛围】
创作一幅空灵缥缈、充满电影感的肖像作品，风格应为“梦幻核”/“暗黑奇幻”。注重氛围、动感和柔和的色调，而非清晰的细节。画面应充满情感、超现实感，并略带一丝萦绕心头的神秘感，如同转瞬即逝的记忆或梦境。

[主体与姿势]
一位年轻女子面对镜头站立，下巴微微抬起，姿态优雅挺拔。她的头轻轻偏向一侧，更添一份自然流畅之感。
她双眼半闭（眼睑下垂），带着梦幻、忧郁、内省的情绪，温柔地凝视着镜头。
她的嘴唇微微张开，营造出一种轻盈、柔美的感觉。

[头发与动态]
她一头浓密乌黑的秀发被风吹得蓬松凌乱，几缕碎发垂落在脸颊两侧，更添动感，散发出一种野性不羁的美感。

【服装及面料】
她身披轻薄透明的白色薄纱或雪纺面料。面料层叠交错，在她周围飘动旋转，部分遮蔽了她的身形，营造出一种幽灵般、仙女般的氛围。

[作品]
中近景镜头。拍摄对象位于画面中心，成为主要视觉焦点。周围元素应显得杂乱而柔和，以增强超现实的氛围。

[灯光]
低调而富有氛围感的灯光。她的脸部被柔和地照亮，成为画面中最亮的部分，而背景则逐渐隐入近乎黑暗。运用微妙的明暗对比效果来营造景深和戏剧性。

[调色板]
柔和简约的色调：深黑色、柔和的白色/米色以及自然的肤色。避免使用鲜艳的色彩，以营造永恒而富有氛围感的氛围。

【效果与氛围】
使用长时间曝光或有意的相机移动（ICM）来创建运动模糊和重影效果。
在画面中添加柔和的条纹或光线轨迹，以唤起时间流逝或精神存在的感觉。
整体采用柔焦效果，只保留面部部分清晰，其余部分则模糊成绘画般的效果。

[品质与风格标签]
电影摄影、艺术人像、柔焦、动态模糊、长曝光、梦幻核、暗黑奇幻、空灵、氛围光、高对比度、艺术模糊、重影效果、超现实氛围

cases.prompt:
英文提示词:
REFERENCE IMAGE INSTRUCTION: Use the uploaded product photo as the exact source of truth for the product's appearance, color, finish, branding, and form factor. Do not invent or alter any product detail. Reproduce it with photorealistic precision.
---
Create a photorealistic premium [PRODUCT CATEGORY] campaign poster in a 4:5 vertical aspect ratio. Design it as a clean global OOH, digital, and social campaign layout with strict grid alignment, premium white space, and precise typography. The campaign idea is "[CAMPAIGN TAGLINE]," but do not render that phrase as visible text.

Use a strict 12-column poster grid with 6% outer margins. Keep all text aligned to this grid. The image has four layers: background shape, giant background typography, subject/product photography, and clean graphic text overlays.

BACKGROUND: Pure matte white canvas. Place one large rounded-rectangle block behind the subject, occupying roughly 70% of the poster height and 76% of the width, centered slightly above the middle. The block uses a controlled [PRIMARY BRAND COLOR] gradient, glowing gently from top-left to bottom-right. Behind the subject and product, place giant cropped typography reading "[BACKGROUND HERO WORD]" in ultra-bold geometric sans-serif letters. The word is a background layer only: huge, partially cropped by the frame edges, wide letter spacing, darker [PRIMARY BRAND COLOR] than the rectangle, subtle embossed depth, soft shadow, and low enough contrast that it does not fight the product.

SUBJECT AND PRODUCT: [DESCRIBE MODEL OR SUBJECT — e.g., "a female model with a clean editorial look, neutral confident expression, natural slightly wind-touched hair, muted off-white outfit, and [ACCENT COLOR] jacket"]. Shoot from a slightly low hero angle. Body angled for depth, face turned toward the viewer with direct eye contact. One hand extends toward the camera holding the product from the uploaded reference image. The product is the dominant foreground object, slightly tilted to reveal [KEY PRODUCT DETAIL — e.g., "the triple camera system, brushed titanium edges, and centered brand logo"]. Keep the product sharp with realistic surface reflections, material texture, faint micro-details, and soft bloom around premium features. Keep the model's face readable behind it.

LIGHTING: Soft studio key light from front-left, warm rim light from the right, and subtle [PRIMARY BRAND COLOR] bounce from the background block. Skin remains natural and non-airbrushed with realistic catchlights. Product edges have clean [MATERIAL FINISH — e.g., "metallic / matte / glossy"] highlights. Shadows are soft and controlled.

TYPOGRAPHY OVERLAY: All text must be flat, crisp, perfectly aligned graphic typography — not painted onto the scene. Render exactly these text elements once, with no extra text:

Top left, small black logo: [BRAND LOGO NAME/MARK]

Top right, thin sans-serif: "[BRAND SUB-TAGLINE — e.g., 'Built for Apple Intelligence.']"

Mid left, glassmorphism pill: "[PRODUCT NAME — e.g., 'iPhone 17 Pro']"

Large background type: "[BACKGROUND HERO WORD]"

Bottom right body copy, small clean sans-serif:
"[PRODUCT NAME]. [POWER STATEMENT — one sentence.]
[FEATURE 1]. [FEATURE 2].
[CLOSING LINE — e.g., 'Designed for what's next.']"

BOTTOM FEATURE STRIP: Place four equal-width glass-white rounded cards along the bottom, aligned to the grid, same height, same spacing, same baseline alignment. Each card has one minimal line icon above the heading. Render exactly:
Card 1: "[FEATURE HEADING 1]" / "[FEATURE SUBLINE 1]"

英文提示词:
BASKIN ROBBINS — “31 FLAVORS. ONE FANTASY.”
ULTRA-PREMIUM GLOBAL FMCG CAMPAIGN

[BRAND = BASKIN ROBBINS]
[STYLE = PLAYFUL LUXURY × CINEMATIC FMCG]
[FORMAT = 4:5 PREMIUM BILLBOARD POSTER]
[CAMPAIGN TYPE = GLOBAL PRODUCT HERO VISUAL]

ACT AS:
A world-class FMCG creative director, luxury dessert advertising specialist, and editorial campaign designer creating a premium Baskin Robbins commercial poster that feels like a fusion of Nike-level campaign execution, luxury beauty advertising, and surreal dessert fantasy branding.

The final visual must feel globally award-winning, emotionally immersive, hyper-premium, internet-culturally relevant, and instantly recognizable as Baskin Robbins while elevating the brand into a modern cinematic luxury universe.

PHASE 1 — CREATIVE CONCEPT

Create a surreal frozen fantasy world built entirely around Baskin Robbins’ iconic identity of flavor abundance, playful happiness, creamy indulgence, and colorful escapism.

The visual should communicate:
“Entering a dream universe made of ice cream.”

NOT a simple product placement poster.

The poster must feel:
• cinematic
• fashionable
• edible
• glossy
• immersive
• youthful
• luxurious
• dreamlike
• emotionally addictive

Core emotional tone:
joy + fantasy + premium craving.

PHASE 2 — HERO PRODUCT DIRECTION

Feature an ultra-detailed Baskin Robbins ice cream scoop composition as the central hero object.

Use:
• strawberry swirl scoop
• blueberry cheesecake scoop
• vanilla cream scoop
• raspberry ribbons
• glossy syrup textures
• realistic creamy depth
• frozen condensation
• melting edges
• hyper-real scoop texture
• visible flavor chunks
• reflective creamy highlights

The scoops should feel:
• cold
• luxurious
• freshly served
• physically craveable
• macro-photographed

Add floating:
• candy particles
• cream splashes
• frozen sugar dust
• syrup arcs
• ice crystals
• glossy droplets

PHASE 3 — ENVIRONMENT DESIGN

Create a massive surreal Baskin Robbins fantasy environment.

Background world:
• pastel dreamscape
• floating creamy clouds
• glossy pink-blue atmospheric haze
• frozen dessert skyline
• surreal candy architecture
• soft reflective marble surfaces
• dreamy cinematic fog
• floating flavor particles
• glowing ice cream nebula atmosphere

Environment must feel:
half luxury fashion campaign,
half fantasy dessert universe.

NO generic AI backgrounds.

Everything should feel art-directed and brand-specific.

PHASE 4 — COLOR SYSTEM

Primary palette:
• Baskin Robbins pink
• aqua blue
• creamy white
• soft lavender
• strawberry tones
• pastel cyan

Accent palette:
• cherry red

Lighting palette:

• glossy highlight reflections
• luxury cosmetic-ad lighting

Avoid:

PHASE 5 — TYPOGRAPHY SYSTEM

“31 FLAVORS. ONE FANTASY.”

MIDGROUND:

dense, immersive, premium, and highly detailed.

中文提示词:
BASKIN ROBBINS — “31种风味。一个幻想。”
全球顶级快消品广告活动

[品牌 = 芭斯罗缤]
[风格 = 俏皮奢华 × 电影感快消品]
[格式 = 4:5 高级广告牌海报]
[活动类型 = 全球产品主角视觉]

扮演角色：
一位世界级的快消品创意总监、奢华甜点广告专家和编辑活动设计师，正在创作一张高级芭斯罗缤商业海报。其质感需融合耐克级别的广告执行力、奢华美容广告风格以及超现实甜点幻想品牌形象。

最终视觉效果必须具备全球获奖水准、情感沉浸感、极致高端、符合互联网文化潮流，且能瞬间识别为芭斯罗缤，同时将品牌提升至现代电影感的奢华境界。

第一阶段 — 创意构思
创造一个完全围绕芭斯罗缤标志性身份——风味丰富、俏皮快乐、奶油享受和色彩逃避——构建的超现实冰冻幻想世界。
视觉传达：“进入由冰淇淋构成的梦想宇宙。”
海报必须感觉：电影化、时尚、诱人食欲、光泽感、沉浸式、年轻化、奢华、梦幻、情绪成瘾。
核心情感基调：喜悦 + 幻想 + 高端渴望。

第二阶段 — 主角产品导向
以超精细的芭斯罗缤冰淇淋球组合作为核心主角。使用：草莓旋纹球、蓝莓芝士蛋糕球、香草奶油球、覆盆子丝带纹理、光泽糖浆纹理、真实的奶油深度、冰冻冷凝水珠、融化的边缘、超真实的冰淇淋球纹理、肉眼可见的风味颗粒、反光的奶油高光。球体应感觉冰冷、奢华、新鲜盛放、极具生理诱惑、宏观摄影质感。添加漂浮的糖果颗粒、奶油溅沫、冷冻糖粉、糖浆弧线、冰晶、晶莹水滴。

第三阶段 — 环境设计
创建一个巨大的超现实芭斯罗缤幻想环境。背景世界包含：柔和色彩的梦境、漂浮的奶油云朵、光泽的粉蓝色大气薄雾、冰冻甜点天际线、超现实糖果建筑、柔软的反光大理石表面、梦幻的电影感烟雾、漂浮的风味微粒、闪烁的冰淇淋星云氛围。环境必须感觉一半是奢华时尚大片，一半是幻想甜点宇宙。拒绝平庸的AI背景，一切都应经过艺术指导并体现品牌特色。

第四阶段 — 色彩系统
主色调：芭斯罗缤粉、水蓝色、奶油白、柔和薰衣草紫、草莓色调、柔和青色。点缀色：樱桃红、焦糖金、亮泽巧克力棕。灯光：柔和霓虹光晕、电影感柔光溢出、亮面高光反射、奢华化妆品广告照明。避免：浑浊色彩、过度饱和、幼稚的彩虹混乱、平淡的渐变。

第五阶段 — 字体系统
字体设计应像奢华时尚广告牌与现代快消品广告的结合。包括：巨大的紧缩体标题、分层透明文本、超大尺寸的“31”、编辑感微型文字、风味标签、弧形字体集成、奢华间距层级、漂浮字体透视。主标语：“31 Flavors. One Fantasy.” 副标语：“Step into the sweetest dimension.” 字体必须成为构图的一部分。

第六阶段 — 构图工程
以电影感的深度层级构建：
前景：糖浆溅沫、漂浮配料、光泽反射、冰淇淋微粒。
中景：巨大的主角冰淇淋球、芭斯罗缤杯、漂浮的奶油纹理。
背景：幻想甜点天际线、巨大的柔和字体、电影感薄雾、氛围光晕。
视觉层级必须引导眼睛依次看向：1. 主角产品 2. 活动标语 3. 芭斯罗缤Logo。

premium,

commercial,

warm,
smooth,

中文提示词:
**GOLDEN MORN 病毒式快消品海报活动系统**
**“金色开启，强健常在。”**

**扮演角色：**
一位资深全球快消品创意总监、奢华早餐食物造型师、高级商业产品摄影师、排版设计师和现代品牌广告商，为一个世界级麦片品牌创作一张具有病毒式传播潜力的 Golden Morn 早餐海报。

**设计风格融合：**
— 高级快消品广告活动
— 现代麦片广告
— 健康生活方式品牌
— 充满活力的 Instagram 食物专题
— 大胆的排版驱动型海报设计
— 色彩丰富的家庭友好型商业美学

**海报视觉感受：**
新鲜、健康、活力、温暖、高端、向上、诱人、极具分享欲望。

**排除项：**
不要电影奇幻感。不要暗黑奢华美学。不要垃圾食品广告。不要杂乱无章。不要平庸的超市画册设计。

这看起来应该像是由顶级全球广告代理商创作的、真实的价值十亿美元的 Golden Morn 广告。

---

### 核心创意风格
整体视觉语言应结合：
— 特大号声明式排版
— 动态的早餐食材运动感
— 极简干净的食物展示
— 高级商业色彩分级
— 现代快消品写实主义
— 充满活力的健康食品能量
— 大胆的平面布局美学

设计应瞬间让人感到：现代、健康、高端、家庭友好、商业化、适合 Instagram 发布。一切都应体现出刻意的艺术指导和全球公认的品质。

---

### 排版风格（最重要）
使用占据背景主导地位的巨大复古现代排版。

**排版要求：**
— 占据构图的 40–60%
— 位于谷物碗的后方和周围
— 感觉大胆且令人振奋
— 能够立即吸引注意力

**字体特征：**
— 特粗、圆润边缘
— 粗犷且柔和的形态
— 复古现代风格
— 粗体无衬线字体
— 俏皮且高端
— 光滑的曲线、紧凑的字间距

**标题结构示例：**
“START GOLDEN”（金色开启）
“MORNING ENERGY”（早晨能量）
“POWER YOUR DAY”（开启动力）
“GOODNESS INSIDE”（内含营养）
“BREAKFAST DONE RIGHT”（完美早餐）

排版应与以下元素自然互动：漂浮的谷物、牛奶飞溅、香蕉、麦片颗粒、蜂蜜滴。在浓郁的金色或天蓝色背景上使用奶油色或白色文字效果极佳。

---

### 主要产品构图
在前景中创建一个超写实的、奶油般的 Golden Morn 谷物碗。谷物看起来应：温暖、平滑、营养、奶油质感、高端。碗周围环绕香蕉片、玉米粒、大豆、燕麦、蜂蜜、牛奶溅射、飘浮的谷粉和新鲜水果。展示奶油般的旋涡、晶莹的牛奶高光和蜂蜜的反射。构图应感觉像是冻结在运动瞬间的高级商业拍摄。

---

### 食物摄影与照明
专业的奢华商业早餐摄影。重点关注：奶油质感、晶莹的牛奶反射、写实照明、诱人的展示。使用明亮的高级商业影棚照明，具有奶油色高光、温暖的晨光和干净的自然阴影。避免阴暗沉闷的灯光。

---

### 背景与色彩
使用大胆的无缝影棚背景。首选颜色：金黄、暖奶油色、天蓝、蜂蜜金。背景应感觉干净、明亮、令人振奋，带有柔和的阳光光晕和微妙的渐变。色彩系统应体现健康、清新、温暖和活力。在排版、谷物碗和背景之间保持强烈的对比和完美的色彩协调。

---

### 构图规则与包装
强有力的视觉层级。图层顺序：巨大的排版背景 > 漂浮的食材 > 主体谷物碗 > 动态飞溅效果 > Golden Morn 包装。包装应看起来有光泽且真实，保持蓝黄品牌色。使用分层深度和对角线运动感，使海报感觉生动、健康且充满动力。

---

### 最终视觉质量
超写实。高级商业早餐摄影。现代快消品广告写实主义。奢华 Instagram 广告品质。看板级构图。高细节食物纹理。锐利的特大号排版。丰富的色彩分级。纵横比 4:5，8K 超高清渲染。

英文提示词:
Design a high-completion 'Chinese Style Food Mascot Badge Logo' based on user inputs: [Brand Name], [Subtitle/Product], [Category/Industry], [Brand Positioning], [Core Keywords], [Character Setting (e.g., ancient girl, master chef, shopkeeper)], [Food Elements (e.g., milk tea, BBQ, noodles)], [Mood/Vibe (e.g., friendly, lively, craftsman)], [Main Color], [Secondary Color], and [Aspect Ratio]. 

Core Goal: Create a commercially viable brand logo integrating a National Tide (Guochao) character, bold Chinese typography, food category info, and a badge structure. It should be suitable for storefront signage, packaging, and social media avatars. 

Design Principles:
1. Logo Priority: It must function as a brand mark, not a complex illustration.
2. Character Design: Memorable and IP-oriented with friendly expressions and food-related actions (holding bowls, skewers, etc.). Use traditional or professional attire.
3. Typography: The brand name must be bold, legible, and have a 'signage' feel with strokes, shadows, or plaque effects.
4. Badge Structure: Integrate elements into a unified unit (e.g., Character above text, circular badge, or plaque structure).
5. Style & Color: Professional 'Guochao' aesthetic with an appetizing color palette. Avoid overly complex, realistic, or low-quality cartoon styles. The background should be clean (white or light grey) to highlight the logo unit.

中文提示词:
请根据用户输入的【品牌名 / 项目名】【副标题 / 产品名】【类型 / 行业】【品牌定位】【核心关键词】【角色设定】【食物元素】【情绪气质】【主色调】【辅助色】【画幅比例】，设计一个高完成度的「国风美食角色徽章 Logo / Chinese Food Mascot Badge Logo」。

【用户输入】
品牌名 / 项目名：【品牌名 / 项目名】
副标题 / 产品名：【副标题 / 产品名】
类型 / 行业：【类型 / 行业】
品牌定位：【品牌定位】
核心关键词：【核心关键词】
角色设定：【如古风少女、老师傅、小厨神、民俗人物、掌柜、侠客、孩童角色等】
食物元素：【如奶茶、烧烤、肉丸、面条、米线、糕点、汤圆、辣椒、锅、碗、筷子等】
情绪气质：【亲切、热闹、老字号、可爱、烟火气、地域感、年轻、匠人感等】
主色调：【主色调】
辅助色：【辅助色】
画幅比例：【画幅比例】

【核心目标】
这次要设计的是一个真正可商用的「国风美食角色徽章 Logo」。它不是普通卡通插画，不是简单餐饮海报，也不是单纯文字 Logo，而是一个以“国潮人物角色 + 醒目中文招牌字标 + 餐饮品类说明 + 徽章式整合结构”为核心的餐饮品牌标志。

整体要让人一眼感受到：这是一个有角色、有食欲、有店铺感、有包装感、适合真实餐饮品牌使用的 Logo。它既可以作为门店招牌，也可以用于外卖头像、包装贴纸、餐盒、杯身、菜单、社媒头像和食品包装正面主视觉。

【设计本质】
这类 Logo 的重点不是单独画一个可爱人物，而是把以下三层整合为一个完整品牌标志：

1. 角色层：负责吸引注意力和品牌人格；
2. 字标层：负责品牌名识别和传播；
3. 徽章层：负责把角色、文字和品类信息整合成一个完整 Logo 单位。

最终效果应像一个成熟的国潮餐饮品牌 Logo，而不是散乱的插画加文字。

【最重要的原则】
1. 这必须首先是一个 Logo，而不是一张插画海报。
2. 角色要有记忆点，但不能压过品牌名。
3. 中文品牌名字标必须醒目、清楚、有招牌感。
4. 整体必须有餐饮消费感、食欲感和包装识别度。
5. 角色、食物、文字、徽章结构必须是一个整体，而不是简单拼贴。
6. 风格要国潮、有趣、有亲和力，但不能廉价、低幼或过度杂乱。文字不要过于密集。

【角色设计要求】
请根据【角色设定】设计一个具有品牌人格的国潮美食角色。

角色设计要求：
1. 角色形象要有明显记忆点；
2. 表情要亲和、有食欲感、有烟火气；
3. 动作要和食物或品类有关，例如端碗、举串、喝奶茶、揉面、炒锅、拿勺、举招牌等；
4. 服装可以带有国风、地域、民俗或餐饮职业特征；
5. 角色应偏品牌 IP 化，不要写实，不要过度复杂；
6. 角色要适合缩小后仍能识别，适合做品牌头像和包装图案。

【食物元素要求】
请围绕【食物元素】加入少量但准确的餐饮符号，例如：
- 碗、锅、筷子、勺子、蒸汽
- 火焰、炭火、辣椒、汤汁
- 奶茶杯、吸管、茶叶、冰块
- 糕点、汤圆、肉丸、面条、串串
- 地域食材、调味料、包装纸、餐盒

食物元素要服务品牌识别，不要堆砌。  
重点是让观众一眼知道这个品牌大概卖什么。

【字标设计要求】
品牌名是 Logo 的核心识别之一，必须清楚、醒目、有招牌感。

中文品牌名字标应具有：
1. 粗壮、有力、饱满的餐饮招牌感；
2. 适度国潮风、复古包装感或卡通字感；
3. 可加入描边、阴影、底托、牌匾、圆角、厚度感；
4. 字体可以略微夸张，但必须可读；
5. 不要太极简，不要像普通系统字体；
6. 字标要和角色风格统一。

【徽章结构要求】
请将角色、品牌名、品类信息整合成完整徽章式 Logo。

可选择以下结构之一：
1. 上方角色 + 下方中文大字标；
2. 角色站在食物或器具上 + 字标作为底托；
3. 圆形 / 椭圆 / 牌匾式徽章结构；
4. 左右对称小牌 + 中央角色；
5. 角色与文字交叠成一个完整品牌章；
6. 底部横向招牌条 + 上方角色 IP；
7. 外卖头像式圆章 / 包装贴纸式结构。

整体应像一个可直接用于食品包装、门店招牌或社媒头像的完整 Logo。

【辅助信息要求】
可以加入少量辅助文字和小标识，例如：
- 品类说明
- 英文副标题
- 创立年份
- 地域标签
- “手作”“现做”“老味道”“秘制”等小字
- 小圆章、小边框、小装饰条

但辅助信息必须克制，不能让画面变成复杂海报。

【风格方向要求】
整体应呈现：
- 国潮感
- 餐饮感
- 包装感
- 角色 IP 感
- 亲和力
- 传播感
- 食欲感
- 地方小吃 / 新消费餐饮品牌气质

整体必须避免：
- 低幼儿童插画感
- 过度复杂海报感
- 纯插画而不像 Logo
- 人物太写实
- 字体太弱
- 颜色太脏太杂
- 信息堆太多
- 缺少餐饮品类识别

【色彩要求】
请根据【主色调】和【辅助色】设计整体配色。

推荐色彩方向：
1. 烧烤 / 火锅 / 重口味：红、橙、黑、土黄、深棕；
2. 甜品 / 奶茶 / 糕点：粉、奶白、浅紫、豆沙红、杏色；
3. 地方小吃 / 面食 / 米线：米白、墨黑、朱红、青绿、土黄；
4. 海鲜 / 清爽食堂：蓝、青、白、红色小印章；
5. 老字号 / 熟食 / 酱料：棕红、暗金、墨黑、米黄。

颜色要有食欲感和品牌记忆点，但不要超过 4～5 个主要颜色。  
亮色点缀可以增强吸睛度，但不能喧宾夺主。

【画面呈现要求】
1. 画面为独立 Logo 展示图，不要做成复杂海报；
2. 背景简洁，推荐白底、米白底、浅灰底或低饱和纯色底；
3. Logo 主体居中，清晰完整；
4. 角色、字标、品类说明和徽章结构必须完整统一；
5. 整体看起来像真实餐饮品牌的 Logo 提案，而不是单张插画。

【验收标准】
请确保最终结果满足以下标准：
1. 一眼能看到品牌名；
2. 一眼能感受到卖什么；
3. 角色有记忆点；
4. 整体是完整 Logo，而不是插画海报；
5. 适合用于门店、包装、餐盒、贴纸、外卖头像和社媒头像；
6. 有国潮美食品牌的亲和力、食欲感和传播感。

【输出要求】
请最终输出一个高完成度的「国风美食角色徽章 Logo」。它必须首先是一个成熟、完整、可品牌化、可应用的餐饮 Logo；其次，它要通过国潮角色、醒目字标、食物元素和徽章结构，形成强识别、强亲和、强传播的美食品牌形象。
